key_insight: YoCausal exposes whether video diffusion models truly grasp causal dynamics or just exploit temporal statistics by using temporally reversed real videos as natural counterfactuals in a Violation-of-Expectation (VoE) style benchmark.
problem_solved: Provides a realistic, low-cost benchmark to evaluate causal understanding in video generation, bridging the sim-to-real gap of prior synthetic tests.
method: Design a two-level VoE-inspired benchmark that tests model sensitivity to causal violations at different temporal scales.
Create natural counterfactuals by temporally reversing real-world videos at zero cost to produce plausible-but-causally-incorrect samples.

Measure and compare model responses (e.g., likelihoods, reconstruction/errors, or discriminative scores) on original vs. reversed videos to detect overfitting to temporal statistics vs. causal reasoning.
impact: Enables practitioners to quantify how far VDMs are from true world models and to diagnose whether improvements reflect causal reasoning or mere pattern memorization. This guides development of more robust, causally-aware generative models and evaluation suites.

paper_title: YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective
